findings.cause: wait reconstructed a RawResultEnvelope from an already frozen payload; JSON lists had become internal tuples and strict raw ingress rejected them
findings.product_fix: preserve the runner RawResultEnvelope identity when terminal status is unchanged and thaw only when a STOPPED status override requires a new envelope

findings.cause: runner calls were outside one linearized lifecycle decision: concurrent start/start could both pass the active-session gate and wait completion could overwrite a concurrent stop
findings.product_fix: reserve STARTING under RLock before runner.start; track in-flight poll and merge its result into the latest state so STOP_REQUESTED wins as STOPPED

findings.cause: an exception after runner.start could leave an externally started session untracked and allow a second developer
findings.product_fix: retain an immutable START_AMBIGUOUS reservation after uncertain start outcome and include it in the one-active-developer gate

findings.cause: ReadOnlyPolicy accepted globally known read verbs without consuming the delegated child permission snapshot
findings.product_fix: require a valid packet PermissionSnapshot and intersect the exact canonical action with child allowed/prohibited actions and packet prohibitions

findings.cause: making C-03 raw result freezing strict risked applying the same rejection to C-04 checkpoint tuple/set state
findings.product_fix: split strict JSON raw-result freezing from the compatibility-preserving checkpoint freezer

findings.cause: stop accepted PENDING before the required first wait transition and forwarded the reverse-order command to the runner
findings.product_fix: permit nonterminal stop delivery only from RUNNING and fail closed from PENDING

findings.cause: an in-flight poll compared object identity and discarded its one-shot terminal result when steer or pause/resume replaced session metadata
findings.product_fix: merge a valid terminal result into the latest same-session projection while preserving instruction, checkpoint, and resume epoch

findings.cause: STOP_REQUESTED alone could not distinguish in-flight, delivered, and failed or unknown delivery, suppressing required retry or reconciliation
findings.product_fix: track stop in-flight and delivery separately, suppress concurrent duplicates, permit retry after delivery exception, and reconcile ack loss through terminal poll
